comps.label: C1

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Orthopedic and pain devices and biologics sold to surgeons and hospitals; different customers and clinical area than home lymphedema therapy.

comps.label: C3

comps.label: C4

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Home-use therapy device manufacturer for chronic conditions, sold via HME providers and patients with insurer reimbursement, similar model to Tactile.
